availability.summary: Open to full stack and software engineering roles

education.school: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology (MAKAUT)

about: I'm a full stack engineer in Kolkata. I work across the whole path of a feature: the React and Next.js interface, the Node.js or Python service behind it, the PostgreSQL or MongoDB data underneath, and the deployment and debugging that keep it running.

At YoForex I build and support production FinTech software: the CRM behind client accounts and money movement, trading interfaces, real-time market data and trading analytics. I joined as a web developer; the role has grown into technical ownership across projects and teams.
Outside work I build AI products end to end. The largest is DevPilot AI, a career co-pilot for developers with a Next.js front end, an Express and TypeScript API, and LLM features on Groq.

principles.title: Design the simplest architecture

principles.title: Build incrementally
principles.detail: Small, reviewable changes that ship behind working flows.

principles.title: Test real user flows
principles.detail: Auth, money movement and failure paths before the happy path.

principles.title: Ship, monitor, improve
